value.rationale: The first admissible even exponent q=6 in circular mixed Fourier extension is a natural endpoint for exact sharp analysis. A contemporary theorem gives the sharp quadratic stability coefficient as a maximum over positive harmonic degrees but does not name the maximizing degree at d=2; the present all-order comparison identifies k=1, uniquely selecting the first harmonic and explicit optimal stability gap/equality class. This is a mathematically motivated sharp invariant and missing spectral classification, not a routine special-function table recomputation or tiny arbitrary parameter slice. An independently reproducible rational separator and rigorous k≥12 analytical cutoff make the exact selection usable.
residual_risks: Scope is deliberately fixed d=2,q=6; no claims about other q or all adjacent positive moment pairs.
The imported 2026 modal framework significantly reduces the genuinely new work, but does not imply the finite/intermediate mode comparisons.

limitations: The all-k theorem uses published fifth-moment and Bessel amplitude estimates; the independent finite computations do not validate infinite order claims on their own.
